messages:
carmen (Marketing): Quick sync: launching the new RefApp Tutorials + short webinar. Decisions needed on announcement tone, benchmark sidebar, signup form fields, and inbound routing.
jiro (DevRel): For benchmarks: show hosted numbers upfront, with a reproducible local bench link in the repo. Keep metrics simple: p50/p95 and tokens/sec.
maya (Product): Also add a brief note about routing/fallback in the demo (canary -> fallback model). helps trust.
alex (Eng): I'll produce a tiny demo script highlighting prefix caching and batching gains. will be <120 lines and include expected outputs.
carmen (Marketing): timeline: blog draft by Wed (1851300000), tutorials + repo by Fri, webinar next Tue. workable?
jiro (DevRel): tight but yes. i'll draft the benchmark sidebar (3 bullets + a suggested small bar chart).
maya (Product): include hidden utm_campaign=refapp-tutorials on the signup form.
carmen (Marketing): routing-bot: propose mapping -> company_size >=100 => sales-enterprise, SDK beta opt-in => devrel-beta, else => growth-inbound. Confirm?
routing-bot: ROUTE_PROPOSAL saved. Suggest adding preferred_sdk_lang (python/js) to form to help triage. Apply on confirm.
jiro (DevRel): add devrel_tag when SDK beta is checked. also request a simple checkbox "Get early SDK access".
carmen (Marketing): form fields final: name, email, company, company_size(select), use_case(short), preferred_sdk_lang(select), checkbox "Get early SDK access". hidden utm_campaign set.
alex (Eng): sample output i'll include in README:
$ python demo.py --model redwood-mini --input "Explain"
Latency p50: 58ms
Tokens/sec: 200
Cache_hit: true
carmen (Marketing): messaging options for top of post: A) "Starter tutorials and refapp to ship LLM features faster." B) "Reference tutorials with reproducible benchmarks to make LLM features predictable." Which do we like?
jiro (DevRel): B resonates more w/ predictability focus. :thumbsup:
maya (Product): A is snappier for social. maybe use both across channels.
carmen (Marketing): owners: marketing=carmen, devrel=jiro, product=maya, eng=alex. i'll drop a draft PR tonight and tag everyone. routing-bot awaiting `apply` command. Thanks! :rocket:
